title: Balanced K-flat model for a derived tensor
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $A$ and $R'$ be commutative $R$-algebras, and let $M$ be a complex of $A$-modules [def-pc-derived-category]. If $P\to M$ is a K-flat resolution in $A$-modules and $F\to R'$ is a K-flat resolution in $R$-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex], then the total complex $P\otimes_R F$ represents $M\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}R'$ in $D(A)$. Multiplication by elements of $R'$ gives commuting endomorphisms in $D(A)$ and hence an $A\otimes_R R'$-module structure on cohomology. The construction is independent of the chosen resolutions up to the canonical isomorphism in the derived category and is functorial in $M$.
